newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin first-half net 1.35 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Michelin first-half net 1.35 bln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - Michelin gave its 1996 first-half results in a financial advertisement.
It said its 1996 first-half results include an exceptional 709 million franc charge for the restructuring of its Spanish subsidiary Neumaticos Michelin SA.
Stripping out exceptional items, Michelin's first-half profit was up 790 million francs over the prior-year level.
Its pre-tax pre-exceptional profit rose close to 50 percent due to an improvement in the operating margin and lower financial expenses.
The drop in financial expense was due to lower interest rates, as the average debt in the first-half held steady.
Operating profit represented 10.4 percent of sales and was 31 percent above the level recorded in the first half of 1995, which was up 26 percent over the first half of 1994.
"The two principal factors behind the improvement in the operating margin were on the one hand, the new price levels, and on the other hand, cost controls," it said.
Tyre price increases, up an average two percent in the first half of 1996 over prior-year levels, showed their full effect in the first half of this year.
